label: Uneasy calm
summary: The Iran war still set the tone. Iran's Revolutionary Guard said four oil tankers caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz, while Trump said the war would end soon and Pakistan's army reported cautious optimism about mediation. Ebola deaths in DR Congo passed 5,000, the country's deadliest outbreak on record, and families in Port Sudan struggled to afford water. Brazil summoned an Argentine diplomat over Flavio Bolsonaro's flight to the US, and police were deployed to Poland's top court after its head judge was suspended. Higher fuel costs left Australian cruise passengers stranded financially. On the brighter side, rescued orangutans returned to Borneo's forest, Hokkaido had its best potato harvest in a decade, a diet-and-exercise trial put more than half of participants into diabetes remission, and astronauts upgraded the space station's power. The weighted formula gave 44; no editorial adjustment.
